title: Saudi Arabia confirms Houthi attack damaged Riyadh's tallest building; Houthis claim strike on wealth fund HQ
detail: Saudi Arabia confirmed a Houthi attack damaged Riyadh's tallest building, while the Houthis claimed a strike on the headquarters of the Saudi sovereign wealth fund. Based on aggregated headlines only; weapon type, extent of damage and casualties are not yet confirmed.

title: Houthis tell airlines to avoid Saudi airspace, warning of coming attacks
detail: Houthis reportedly warned airlines to avoid Saudi airspace, signaling coming attacks. Based on an aggregated headline only; the originating outlet, scope of the warning and any Saudi response are not yet confirmed.

title: Saudi-led coalition reportedly strikes Hodeidah port; Houthis warn of retaliation
detail: Aggregated headline reports Saudi Arabia-led coalition airstrikes on the port of Hodeidah, with the Houthis warning of retaliation. Based on a headline only; the originating outlet, damage and casualties are not yet confirmed.

title: Loud explosion heard in Riyadh after Saudi civil defence alerts
